wins: Consistent scanning cadence delivered a comprehensive inventory of exposed services before the timer expired
Maintained operational discipline by escalating mentor guidance at fixed intervals following each failed action to maximize learning feedback
fails: Zero percent success rate due to inability to complete post-exploitation objectives within run timeframe
Repeated stalling while attempting lateral movement; no foothold established in the target after initial reconnaissance
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was thorough but the run failed to convert findings into actionable exploit sequences, leaving objectives unmet.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: SSH exploitation attempts timed out because no valid authentication or known vulnerabilities were present

skill_cards.if_condition: When a TCP scan shows port 22 open and an SSH banner fingerprint is captured
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap scripts (ssh-hostkey, ssh-auth-methods) followed by enumeration via ssh-audit

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration finishes with available HTTP endpoints but login forms are present
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy BurpSuite spider + forced directory enumeration via gobuster with wordlist

memory_ops.reason: High reliability in reconnaissance phase when SSH services are identified
Consistent discovery of HTTP endpoints that could yield further access opportunities
